description: Build a four-step checkout funnel by device: view_cart -> begin_checkout -> add_payment -> purchase. A session reaches step N only if it reached step N-1 and has a step-N event with a timestamp greater than or equal to the timestamp at which it first reached step N-1 (strict ordered funnel). Count distinct sessions per device at each step. Output columns: device (STRING), view_cart (INT64), begin_checkout (INT64), add_payment (INT64), purchase (INT64).
edge_cases: Session s3 skips intermediate steps, so its purchase does not count in the strict funnel
Session s4 has no checkout events and contributes to no step
Repeated events for the same step count the session once
Each step count must be less than or equal to the previous step count
common_failure_modes: FM3: COUNTIF(step = 'purchase') per device counts sessions that skipped steps and counts repeated events
FM1: Chained self-joins without deduplicating per session fan out when a step repeats
FM7: No monotonicity check lets later steps exceed earlier ones
